summary: FirstService Corporation filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release dated August 20, 2026, announcing that the Toronto Stock Exchange accepted its notice of intention to conduct a normal course issuer bid. The NCIB permits purchases of up to 3,930,112 common shares, representing 10% of the 39,301,122-share public float as of August 12, 2026, over the 12-month period from August 26, 2026 to August 25, 2027, at prevailing market prices. NASDAQ purchases are capped at 5% of outstanding shares; TSX daily limits are 32,962 shares, with 43,669,770 shares outstanding. No board recommendation or advisor is named. All shares acquired will be cancelled. The buyback signals management's view that shares may trade below intrinsic value; watch actual purchase cadence and any acceleration as a sentiment indicator.
